seed.basis: E6-LINK-OPTIONAL-DESIGN.md Probe L2: append <required>false</required>, <startExpression>SortKey</startExpression>, <linkConditionExpression>SortKey > 0</linkConditionExpression> to L1's already-accepted dataSetLink. required=false is deliberately non-default (EDT defaultValue "true") to test omission-semantics. Insertion order is explicitly a hypothesis per the design ("Порядок вставки — гипотеза").

compiler_acceptance.method: ibcmd-rs common source compiler body (compile_dcs on the retained round-2 native Template.xml; the evidenced cohort parser requires platform storage order) overlaid via the common overlay APIs into the retained clean-room CF, loaded and applied in a fresh ru_RU file infobase, saved, then Report.DcsCorpus recursively exported by the pinned original ibcmd

negative_observations: The platform reorders the three newly-added optional children (required, startExpression, linkConditionExpression) to linkConditionExpression, startExpression, required in the canonical re-export -- neither the submitted order nor alphabetical order.

required=false (non-default relative to EDT's declared defaultValue "true") is retained verbatim in the re-export, not omitted or coerced to the default -- directly answers the design's omission-semantics question for this field.
parameterListAllowed=true (from L1) remains present and unchanged alongside the three new L2 fields.
non_claims: No claim about the canonical order of these three fields in any submission order other than the one tested (required, startExpression, linkConditionExpression) -- a different submitted order might or might not produce the same canonical order.
No claim about linkItem containment, multiple dataSetLink elements, or parameter value lists -- explicitly out of scope per the design.
